notes.title: 3rd Anniversary of HARDCORE MECHA! 52% OFF Historical Low!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35220584/d95c7e7f8f5966d942da96f45c604922f8e128ad.png[/img]

[b]Happy 3rd Anniversary of HARDCORE MECHA![/b]

Steam Summer Sale is underway again. Every tear at this time, we'll be seeing big discount and it is the time to snap up a bargain.

 We'll also recall all the memory about Hardcore Mecha's release at that time. ( HaMei (which is the first two initials in English and means a cute little girl in Chinese) is the nickname of HARDCORE MECHA called by team members, so we use HaMei to refer in the following content)

It's hard to believe that it's already been 3 years since HARDCORE MECHA 's release! HaMe is 3 years old and is a cute lady already!  

From a small studio of three people, working on a "hovering balcony" (our balcony is on the outside of the building and looks like it's hovered in the air), to the release of the prototype machine on Weibo. Even though little people shows interest in that, it slowly attracted many like-minded friends to join the team and to form the original 7 people of  "Unlicensed Developer Group".From the beginning of crowdfunding on Kickstarter, to the little-known project at Tokyo Games Show; from the success of crowdfunding, to the Independent Game Award at Tokyo Game Show.
Even though the game was postponed twice and finally came out to face the patiently waiting players, it unexpectedly won a variety of super cool achieements and awards, including the PlayStation Indies&developer game awards. HaMe witnessed RocketPunch and all RocketPunch developers' one and another first time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35220584/bef6fd5df23d8be8e64155d4cd3cb559a57c5c01.png[/img]
（[i]hovering balcony[/i]）

In this journey of ups and downs, we have gained too much. Looking back at our own design of mecha body into physical models, our own creation of the game launched more platforms and even successfully collaborated with our own favorite animation, nothing can happen without all your support!

We would like to take the opportunity of the 3rd birthday of HaMe to say a word to you, to who have been with us for three years. THANK YOU, THANK YOU SOOOOO MUCH!

In the future, with the company of HaMe, we will work harder and harder to make more and more interesting games, and to fight the strongest "Rocket Punch"!

At last, in order to celebrate HaMei's third birthday, Hardcore Mecha will start a new lowest discount on Steam. opening time: June 22 0:00 to June 24 0:00 and June 24 1:00 am to July 8 1:00 am (CST). If you'd like join the Ace pilot, please pay attention to the recent Steam Summer Sale~~

At the final last, we hope the COVID pandemic ends soon and all goes well with the two projects that currently we're working on, and hope you all happiness!
Making games is really great!

notes.title: Optimized performance & Introduce the new Replay Feature!
notes.notes:
Dear Ace Pilots！

It is almost the end of the year, 2020 has been a year like no other in our lifetime.
We would like to send our thoughts and best wishes to everyone, and we feel super lucky to have all our players’ support.

In this last update for HARDCORE MECHA this year, we are introducing the brand-new Reply Function, which can be used to record exciting matches to view as playback and share with friends!

[b]Below is the list of updates:[/b]

- Introducing ‘Replay Function’

Save replay function added. Online Battles will automatically save replays by default, while a prompt will appear after Local Battles. Go to Settings to change replay save configurations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35220584/7ade4ba02e9b80b4c68e2da34897b659e95563d4.jpg[/img]

Replay browser interfaces added. Enter via the Multiplayer menu to inspect, play, pin, or delete locally saved replay info.
When the number of replay files reaches the storage limit, the system will delete the oldest unlocked replay files first. So please remember to lock the replay files you would like to keep.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35220584/1b7aadc2c4eb1aac7f490de2a6df66ce5bbe7bc7.jpg[/img]

Play replay function added. Adjust speed, switch players, or switch to free cam while playing a replay, We hope these functions will be helpful for you in battle analysis and video creation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35220584/43861701f25dc8afe4a7072dbc3a890734986d54.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35220584/d0b64d271ff36fc206ea623567f97b72f9836737.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35220584/83ac5c83b6322952efa00d29cb641a10ef589f69.jpg[/img]

*Replay files will be save here: C:\\\Users\\\Your Windows Account\\\AppData\\\LocalLow\\\RocketPunch Games\\\HARDCORE MECHA\\\Saves\\\ReplayFiles
Or entre: %appdata%/../LocalLow/RocketPunch Games/HARDCORE MECHA/Saves/ReplayFiles
*replay files are not video files and can only be played within the game. Since the replay files generated under the old version can no longer be played after the game is updated, it is recommended that you permanently save your favourite battle moments through screen recording before the update


[b]Adjustments to Simulation Mode[/b]
	●Enhanced the functionality of advanced weapons in Simulation Mode.
	●Added intermediate and advanced attachments for sale.
	●Changed lowest quality of dropped intermediate and advanced attachments to green.

[b]Adjustments to Multiplayer[/b]
Dragoon / Sabre
	●Reduced the damage of Dragoon’s dual-beam cannons.
	●Reduced the damage of Dragoon’s charge cannon.
	●Increased Dragoon’s kill score.
	●Decreased Sabre’s kill score.

	Halberd
	●Reduced guided-missile speed.
	●Reduced guided-missile capacity.
	●Increased APCR missile damage.

We wish you a safe and an early Happy new year, may the New Year bring good health, happiness and good fortune. 

A blessed festive season to all!

notes.title: The drill to break heaven!!! New DLC ——Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagann
notes.notes:
[h3]Classical mecha animation Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagann collaborate with action game first! Gurren Lagann, Lagann, and Simon are all under your control.

Witness the time and the space to be broken! Your drill will break heaven!!

Brand new Hardcore Mecha DLC Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagan is live now![/h3]

[previewyoutube=J0jca8SLNl4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]From the developer[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35220584/5618ee6a6861f286d1d7864827c38912e34705a8.gif[/img]

Gurren Boomerang、Skull Break、Full Drillized、Fire Cart Kick、Giga Drill Break...
Under the technology limit and game balance, We reduce most abilities in the game, and these can be controlled by your hands.

If you ask us what we insist, so we have to mention the most important feature of Hardcore Mecha------To make players feel the mecha from the anime, and this time we did it again.

For example, in the anime when Gurren Lagan throws its glasses out to freeze the enemy than raise its giant drill. Generally speaking, these two movements should be together and hit the target 100%, but we decide to split them into two parts,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35220584/e506d95090830b6c244cb676016c3779958c8de0.gif[/img]

Players will find out Giga Drill Break is hard to hit someone who has prepared for defense, so this time you need to charge Gurren Boomerang to freeze the enemy, then dash to cancel backswing, so you can start Giga Drill Break. When you finish your enemy with your combo, we believe everyone can understand why Kamina create these with his life. If everyone can feel what Simon feels when he cast abilities, we will very glad to see that.

Thanks to the pilot feature, we can restore Simon in the game. We design ability with high damage for Simon------Core Drill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35220584/4adebd544cda758331740c2695383353c30c8fb3.gif[/img]

 Just like the battle of the Spiral King in the anime, everyone has a chance to damage the enemy's mecha.

[b]There is still much exciting design in the game, but we hope the player can find them out in the DLC. We hope you enjoy the game![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1344050/1/

[b]This DLC contains Gurren-Lagann, Lagann and pilot Simon. The DLC supports Local & Online Multiplayer Mode, Training Mode and Single-player Simulation Mode.
*To unlock Simulation Mode by completing Campaign Mode.[/b]

notes.title: Update Version 1.12 - Optimized performance in Multiplayer Mode
notes.notes:
Long time no see fellow Ace pilots,

Hope you all have been enjoying multiplayer battles with friends and family!

We want to thank you all for the continuous feedback, we have been reading every single piece of advice, and updating the game to ensure you will get the best experience!

Today we have optimized the following in Multiplayer mode:
 
        [b]Thunderbolt[/b]
	●Beam Rifle damage is further reduced by distance.

	[b]Crimson Flame[/b]
	●New defence action added.

	[b]Round Hammer[/b]
	●Defence Shield speed slightly increased.
	●Firing main cannons horizontally will directly strike the enemy.

	[b]Geier EVOL[/b]
	●Reduced speed of Flight Mode.
	●Beam SMG fire rate increased and changed bullet design.
	●Rocket capacity increased.

	[b]Viperid[/b]
	●Beam gun damage is further reduced by distance in Normal Mode.
	●Beam Cannons will no longer destroy your own Floating Mines.
	●Melee attacks have been changed to dash attacks.

	[b]Knell A3[/b]
	●The cooldown of Rocket Anchor has been greatly reduced.
	●Energy cost of Boost has been greatly reduced.
	●Increased damage of melee attacks mid-air.
	●Reduced charge up of melee attacks mid-air.

	[b]Dragoon / Sabre[/b]
	●Greatly reduced the value of Dragon Shield, but increased recovery speed.
	●Increased fire rate of dual-beam guns, but decreased damage.

	[b]Halberd[/b]
	●Increased AOE range and damage of Guided Missiles, but decreased direct damage.
	●Main weapon missile lock-on time decreased.
	●Shield penetrating missiles have the ability to cause Freeze.

	[b]Shepherd Support Type[/b]
	●Reduced cooldown of Radar.
	●Switching to Sniper Mode is now faster.
	●Secondary weapon—Chest Vulcan—has been changed to grenades.
	●SMG bullet speed increased, but range has decreased.
	●Melee attacks have been changed to dash attacks.

	[b]C.R.U.S.H.[/b]
	●Score has been reduced.
	●Greatly increased shield value, and guard no longer takes damage.
	●Greatly increased Energy consumed by melee attacks, but melee damage is increased and adds super armour.

	[b]Seeker III[/b]
	●Greatly increased dual pistol fire rate, but slightly decreased damage.
	●Decoy Missile display changed to look like actual mechas.

	[b]Geier IDS[/b]
	●Increased AOE range and damage of bombs, but decreased direct damage.
	●Increased main weapon missile capacity.
	●Missile lock-on time decreased.

	[b]Buccaneer[/b]
	●All melee damage has been increased.
	●Hand Grenade AOE damage increased.

	[b]Heavy Assault Engineer[/b]
	●Rocket Launcher damage increased.
	●Shoulder Mines now fire 4 at a time. The total damage has been increased, but direct damage has decreased.
	●Melee attacks have been changed to dash attacks.

	[b]Kurenai Edge[/b]
	●Greatly reduced Energy consumed by melee attacks.
	●Added slight Energy recovery when descending.

	[b]Typhoon Heavy Type[/b]
	●Melee cooldown decreased.
	●Pistol damage increased.

	[b]Arash[/b]
	●Switching to Sniper Mode is now significantly faster.
	●You can now deploy Floating Mines while in Sniper Mode.
	●Reduced Sniper Rifle firing speed, but decreased single-fire Energy consumption.

	[b]Round Hammer Particle Cannon[/b]
	●Switching to Cannon Mode is now faster.
	●Ground Boost speed increased.
	●Increased range of fire for Particle Cannon when shooting targets from above.

	[b]Shepherd Jäger[/b]
	●Throwing Knife cooldown increased, but damage is also increased.

	[b]Graeme[/b]
	●Energy cost of Boost has decreased.
	●New mid-air melee attack added.

	[b]Assault Pilot[/b]
	●Rifle Grenade cooldown decreased and damage increased.
	●Assault Rifle fire rate increased and damage dealt to Mechas slightly increased.

	[b]Edgar Fieldbach[/b]
	●Grenade cooldown decreased, but damage increased.

	[b]Tarethur O'Connell[/b]
	●Grenade cooldown decreased, but damage increased.

That’s all for this time! Thank you everyone and see you next time!
Happy Gaming!

ANNO: Mutationem is a 2.5D Pixel art-styled Cyberpunk Action-Adventure game, filled with RPG elements.

Welcome to the neon-covered, 2D-meets-3D Cyberpunk world of ANNO: Mutationem. In this Action-Adventure game with RPG elements, you become Ann: a highly-skilled combat-trained lone wolf on a personal mission in a giant Metropolis, full of sinister mega-corporations, mysterious fringe groups and creatures more bizarre than words can express.

notes.title: Version update 1.11, PVP experience upgrade
notes.notes:
Nothing can stop us delivering the latest updates to our players, not even during this troubling time.

We as a small indie dev team has been hurt again and again by the complicated network environment setting for the game’s online PVP feature. The good news is that we did not give up! And have finally managed to improve the PVP features, we cannot wait to share this massively optimized experience with you! 

This update includes:

[h3] Added in AI battle bots, supporting both local multiplayer & online PVP modes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35220584/a432637f2d04ce216e8db7ac291175e0087cf9b8.jpg[/img]

Introducing AI battle bots with 3 different skill levels, available in both local multiplayer & online PVP modes. By adding AI battle bots into your team or as opponents, making an exciting battle easier than ever!  

[h3] fully customizable controller configuration setup [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35220584/cef4d747759541dcb17c56229af6a9af16a47b17.jpg[/img]

Players can now enjoy fully customized controller setup. Pilots who were bothered by the default key settings, now is your time to shine! (And we encourage everyone to share your settings in the community!)
Considering how every pilot has different operating habit, we also prepared separate controller setting for [b]each player[/b] in the Local multiplayer game mode.  

[h3] Improved efficiency for multiplayer matchmaking [/h3]
HARDCORE MECHA’s matchmaking network performance now with significant improvement.

[h3] Fixed the instability of the battle room due to individual high ping player[/h3]

[h3]Added in basic tutorials for multiplayer game mode[/h3]

[h3]Now supporting French and Russian[/h3]

[h3]Optimized art details in the Story mode[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35220584/47594662b6d09b2026a7efea54d412cc5085c349.png[/img]

That’s all for this time’s update! Stay healthy and safe everyone!

notes.notes:
Dear ACE pilots! Long time no see! We have brought back a great update for you!

This update includes:

[h1]Difficulty selection is added in singleplayer mode[/h1]
To satisfy the needs of both "enjoy the story" and "face the challenge", you can select the from "easy" or "normal" when creating the save. [b]Also, you can change the difficulty at any time later in the game.[/b]

[h1]The startup frames of some enemies in singleplayer mode have been fixed to improve player experiences[/h1]
We are still trying our best to avoid those "stun to death" situations.

[h1]AIs in the 2-1 stealth mission have been optimized for smoother experience[/h1]

[h1]Chinese voice over added[/h1]
[previewyoutube=CF52Af8o8wM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
Due to the limited development budget and time, HARDCORE MECHA only includes Japanese voice over when released. However, this update will change this situation. We went over the lines over and over again to adapt the Chinese culture and also [strike]added some swears and dialects[/strike]. We also invited many famous voice actors for this. Come and see how many familiar voices you can find in the game!

[h1]EXPs can also be gained in custom matches[/h1]
The exact same ammount of EXPs can be gained from custom matches as well! Say farewell to those laggers, invite your friends and play a good game!

[h1]New sniper mecha added for multiplayer: Halberd Guided Model[/h1]
[previewyoutube=mApCIU85gis;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
As you can see, this is a mecha built around the missiles. The mecha that satisfy your dark ambush desire.
Since the missiles are so interesting so fun, in order to let the players experience the missiles-all-over-the-sky scene, we broke the rules and decided:
[b]The multiplayer mecha Halberd Guided Model will be released as a free update for the game. Any player reaches level 6 can unlock it immediately.[/b] Hands and feet are just decorations, missiles are the true thing!
ACE pilots, with missiles in your hands, Dragoon will no longer be your opponent. Go!

notes.title: 1.05 Update released today! Also with Artbook, OST, and new mechas and pilots available for purchase!
notes.notes:
This 1.05 update includes many improvement and adjustment, mainly focused on the feedbacks players gave us in the first month after launch. These new contents should be able to improve your user experience effectively. Also, we still expect to hear from you. Your feedbacks are the power of our hard working development!

[h1]New Contents[/h1]
[list]
[*] Training levels added in singleplayer game.Kindly follow the instruction given by Qin, players can practice and master their combat skills in 5 different trainig levels. (Undefeated for 2000 trainig battles is always the key to ace pilot.)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35220584/e1d21e915ec1180676f2c5deb5560e957ab36547.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35220584/21a64149e9d7600e3d0389a359f74f0ce4e41b25.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35220584/6e2eb43c69ad5899e81fef2ec331b47da5a7894d.jpg[/img]

[*] Map "Tiamat Dock" added in multiplayer game.This is a small sized map. Melee-focused mechas can easily approach to their enemies and attack them. Also, the narrow structure made sniper mechas superior in this map.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35220584/90fd7263a204bfdf4f6bad591550176bc14a9648.jpg[/img]

[*] Career stats added in multiplayer game.Players can look up their stats here, including number of selection for different mechas, K/D ratios and so on. The data starts calculate from this update, and counts only for quick matchs.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35220584/fa8677750d02bf615460ced491cc343f06a769e0.png[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Improvements and Adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] In singleplayer mode, repair stations now recover items and ammos for additional weapons. Players can use the items and additional weapons more. Just remember to equip them in customize.
[*] In singleplayer mode, fast cutscene skip button has been added. Hold cancel button on your controller (or Space on your keyboard) to skip cutscenes without having to open the pause menu.
[*] In settings, horizontal assist switch has been added. Players can't get used to it can turn it off for accurate aiming in horizontal axis.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35220584/3fbcd16d94fbfdb7e96c4f82dbd94b74f36fcd8b.jpg[/img]

[*] In singleplayer mode, Shield Strike has been changed to match its description. Attacks from the front can be blocked when using Shield Strike.
[*] In singleplayer mode, New Model Joint Motor now not only reduce cooldown times for melee moves, but also increases the damage dealt by melee attacks.
[*] In singleplayer mode, damage dealt by ultimate skills has been increased, but ultimate skills no longer fill the ultimate skill gauge.
[*] In singleplayer mode, Easy Mode Enhance Device has been enhanced more.
[*] In multiplayer mode, the match result has been changed for clearer data display. Players can also check out their detailed stats like number of assist kills.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35220584/e50750942109139199fba7311d235a8fc6dfdeee.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35220584/1b536542f968b692f07a12489a68e7df14286eb8.jpg[/img]

[*] In multiplayer mode, a basic anti-botting mechanism has been added. Normal players have lower chance to be matched up with a botting player. (Though we have little experience on this issue, we'll continue to improve it and to create a better gaming environment for the players.)
[*] Other fixes to increase the game performance and stability.
[/list]

[h1]New Contents For Steam Store[/h1]
[list]
[*] Multiplayer DLC - Additional playable mecha - Round Hammer Particle Cannon This mecha can only be obtained by buying the Round Hammer Particle Cannon figure. It is now available for every player to buy and use in the multiplayer game. Self-explosion is always the basic for ace pilot, don't you wanna go for it?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35220584/01bedf2251fa1d99846709f119cbac38cef9fe2d.png[/img]

[*] Multiplayer DLC - Additional playable mecha & pilot - Sheperd Jäger & Morris Yaser Shepherd Jäger, with its melee attack strengthened around its sabre, and Captain Morris, the sword master, will always be an opponent others can't ignore.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35220584/90211989fa226d785e1f6b73365e5da0527ae2b7.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35220584/76c7ea77bc92212aa418dcc81e4742b4263e147f.png[/img]
[*] Multiplayer DLC - Additional pilots - Tarethur O'Connell, Edgar Feuerbach, Aylatanya Kiruna [strike]This set of pilots from Hardcore Defense Corps., can be used to do screenshot and video recording to tell stories?![/strike]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35220584/b5dc8746be2170f18edcfa049ae615552b8744a8.png[/img]

[*] HARDCORE MECHA Digital Artbook debut! The Digital Artbook contains an in-depth, behind-the-scenes look at all the mechas, character and environments in HARDCORE MECHA that help you understand the whole world besides the main storyline of HARDCORE MECHA. The digital artbook contains a total of 85 pages, in PDF format. You can read it directly by the Chrome browser or other PDF readers.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35220584/f921d058e37ed6ecf5aa3228df385949067a9960.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35220584/b975e6c7f2e59b4554a0137850fded481e7beeaf.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35220584/2f5f322e67fa305d2af11e7c0bd9161d9d2c0a69.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35220584/f94c72450afaafc2a2a35a4978a1d5394a01fc4f.png[/img]

[*] HARDCORE MECHA OST Release! The OST contains 39 pieces of music, including the OP "Dash & Strike" and ED "Step Into Lights", with a total of 1 hour 41 minutes.

notes.title: HARDCORE MECHA V1.04 Repairable Update, Experience Optimization！
Hardcore Mecha is the anime robo-shooter I've always dreamed of
notes.notes:
Out now, Hardcore Mecha is a platform shooter that feels designed to fulfil a very specific wish: That the gorgeous attack animations from the Super Robot Wars SRPG series were interactive. From the little but I’ve played so far, I reckon they’ve pulled it off, even if the mecha are obviously inspired by famous anime, rather than licensed designs. Developed by RocketPunch Games, it’s a primarily single player, story-heavy run-and-gunner, with a local or online PvP party mode. See in in motion below, in what appears to be several trailers cut into one big shiny showcase video.
